name: Tritoni
description: The Tritoni are not fish — they are closer kin, in some deep biological sense, to the great warm-blooded creatures of the sea: seals, whales, beings that chose the water but never surrendered the lung. Bipedal and broadly humanoid, they are built for the ocean in ways that become apparent on land. Their gills require daily attention above the waterline, and their movements are slower on dry ground than in open water. They carry the unhurried ease of beings who know the sea will still be there.
